name: Lobbit Carousel CPT for Elementor
author: Antonio Morlino

sections.description:
Lobbit Carousel CPT for Elementor adds a carousel widget to Elementor. Its slides are not a few fields of text and an image: each slide is a content item of its own, designed with Elementor like a small page, with any widget you like — headings, text, buttons, images, icons, forms.

It works with the free version of Elementor: you do not need Elementor Pro and its templates to build rich slides.

How it works

  1. Create the slides in the Carousel Slides menu and design each one with Elementor.
  2. Optionally group them in Slide Categories, to show a different set on each page.
  3. Add the Carousel CPT widget to a page and choose the slides one by one, by category, or all of them.

The carousel

  • The next slide peeks from the edge of the screen, so visitors see at once there is more.
  • The first slide lines up with the content of the page (you give the CSS selector of the content area, for example #primary), and the row runs to the right edge of the screen.
  • How many slides are visible on desktop, tablet and mobile, with decimals: 3.2 shows three slides and a bit of the fourth.
  • Space between the slides on each device.
  • Slides of the same height, whatever their content.
  • Arrows, dots and loop.
  • Order by the order of the slides, date, title or at random; how many to show.

Style of the slides

Background, padding, border radius, shadow and minimum height, plus a border on one side only (right, left, top, bottom) or all around, drawn by the carousel and not by the content of the slide.

Image mode

No slides to design? The same widget also shows a row of images, each as wide as its height allows, with the height chosen per device.

The carousel uses Swiper, the slider library that Elementor already loads: no extra library is added to your pages.

The interface is ready for translation; translations are delivered through translate.wordpress.org.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor.
  2. In WordPress go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Lobbit Carousel CPT for Elementor”, install and activate. Or upload the zip from Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Open Carousel Slides → Add New Slide, give the slide a title (only you see it) and press “Edit with Elementor”.
  4. In a page, add the Carousel CPT widget and choose the slides.

Carousel Slides → About explains the steps again and has the support form.
sections.faq:
Does it need Elementor Pro?

No. It is made for the free version of Elementor, and works with Pro too.

Can a slide contain several widgets, columns or containers?

Yes. A slide is designed with Elementor like any page: containers, columns and every widget you have.

What do I write in “Line up with”?

The CSS selector of the element that holds the content of your pages, so the first slide starts where your text starts. It depends on the theme: #primary, #content, .site-main or the class of a boxed Elementor container are common. If the selector matches nothing, the carousel starts at the left edge of the screen. Place the widget in a full-width container for the best result.

The page scrolls sideways

The slides run past the right edge of the screen on purpose. Most themes hide what goes past the edge; if yours does not, add overflow-x: clip; to the body in Appearance → Customize → Additional CSS.

Are the slides visible on their own address?

Slides have no addresses of their own in menus, searches or sitemaps; WordPress opens one only for Elementor’s editor and preview, or with its plain link (?lobbit_cce_slide=…).

What happens to my slides if I delete the plugin?

The slides stay in the database, as with any content, and come back if you install the plugin again.
